failure_reason: Direct HTTP fetch worked throughout (no WAF/DataDome/CAPTCHA on any real content page). A path-class anti-scan trigger began redirecting /shop/* requests to /blocked?url=... partway through investigation (see bs194.json failure_reason for the same detail); /cp/ and /browse/ pages kept returning 200 throughout, so the Clearance-specific facet page below was captured cleanly before that. Not fully ruled out: whether Appliances, Mattresses, Luggage, or Kids' Rooms (Home-dept sub-nodes not directly fetched) carry their own dedicated Clearance page distinct from the whole-Home facet found.
notes: SCOPE: Home dept (cat_id 4044) + Furniture + Patio & Garden (5428) + Home Decor, not the whole store (see bs194.json for the same scope reasoning). SALE-VS-CLEARANCE TEST: Walmart's Home-department mega-menu (/cp/home/4044) has a top-level nav GROUP literally named 'Clearance' (sibling to 'Deals', 'Only at Walmart', etc - i.e. the site's own taxonomy treats Clearance as its own category, not folded into the temporary 'Deals'/Rollback group), with one child link 'All Home Clearance' -> https://www.walmart.com/browse/4044?facet=special_offers%3AClearance. This passes the brief's test (own taxonomy label, not just sale-worded copy). Kept this row. EXCLUDED as Sale-not-Clearance: (a) the Home dept's 'Deals' nav group ('All Home Deals' -> /shop/deals/all-home and its many sub-department links) which the page's own facet sidebar shows contains a mix of 'Rollback', 'Reduced Price' AND 'Clearance' - i.e. a generic temporary-promo hub, not a Clearance-labelled page itself; (b) a sitewide 'Clearance' page discovered via a Bedding-hub footer utility link (https://www.walmart.com/shop/deals/clearance, h1 'Clearance', totalItemCount 1781/(1000+)) - while this page IS explicitly labelled Clearance by the site, it is NOT Home-scoped: its own 'Departments' facet lists Toys, Video Games, Character Shop, Jewelry & Watches, Cell Phones, etc. alongside Home, and product-brand facets sampled from it (Disney, Marvel, PAW Patrol, Barbie, Hot Wheels, Minecraft) confirm it is a whole-store clearance hub. Attempted to scope it to Home via '?cat_id=4044' - the response was byte-for-byte identical to the unfiltered page (same 2,119,626-byte HTML, same totalItemCount 1781), proving the cat_id query param is not honored server-side on this endpoint (the real per-department filter apparently requires an internal shelf_id/store combination not reproducible from a plain GET) - so this page cannot be reliably reduced to Home scope and was excluded per the brief's explicit 'not the whole store' instruction rather than mis-scoped in. COUNT METHODOLOGY (kept row): browse/4044?facet=special_offers:Clearance returns totalItemCount 900010 with totalItemCountDisplay capped '(1000+)'. Cross-checked against the SAME node's own unfiltered baseline (browse/4044, no facet): totalItemCount 900009 - i.e. applying the Clearance filter changed the reported total by +1 out of 900,009, which is not possible for a real filter (a filtered subset cannot exceed, or be statistically indistinguishable from, its unfiltered parent). This is the same 'capped display = internally inconsistent count, not exhaustion-checkable' pattern documented in this company's prior Home-Decor pass (Picture Frames 206 vs 1021, Canvas Wall Art self-facet 331,918 exceeding its own parent's 300,010) - so qty is set to null with a MANUAL REVIEW flag rather than reporting the meaningless 900010 figure. No department-specific Clearance hubspoke/nav link was found on the Décor, Furniture, Storage & Organization, Bath, Kitchen & Dining, or Patio & Garden hub pages (only the one Home-department-level nav link above, plus the out-of-scope sitewide page).

rows.evidence: JSON totalItemCount:900010, totalItemCountDisplay:"(1000+)" - capped and internally inconsistent (unfiltered Home baseline browse/4044 reports totalItemCount:900009, i.e. applying the Clearance facet does not reduce the count at all)
rows.flag: MANUAL REVIEW: totalItemCountDisplay capped '(1000+)'; underlying totalItemCount (900010) is statistically indistinguishable from the unfiltered Home department's own baseline total (900009), proving the special_offers:Clearance facet is not functionally restricting results at this node - consistent with this company's prior-pass finding that Walmart's capped facet counts are inflated/unreliable and not exhaustion-checkable at this scale. The page is a genuine site-labelled Clearance listing (kept), but its reported count cannot be trusted.
